issue_title: [Bug] next_id 可能返回负值或重复 ID，当 todos 列表中存在负 ID 或非连续 ID 时
fix_summary: Fixed next_id to only consider positive IDs when calculating the next available ID, preventing negative or zero return values when todos list contains negative IDs (e.g., from manual JSON tampering).
acceptance_criteria_met: When todos list contains negative IDs, next_id returns a positive integer > 0
When todos list is empty, next_id returns 1
When todos list only has positive IDs, behavior remains unchanged (returns max ID + 1)
